body_text:
Identity theorem. Let $U$ be a connected open subset of
$\mathbb{C}$ and let $f,g:U\to\mathbb{C}$ be holomorphic. If the
set $\{z\in U:f(z)=g(z)\}$ has an accumulation point in $U$, then
$f=g$ throughout $U$. In particular, a nonzero holomorphic
function has isolated zeros.
